content.raw:
What is Adtek?

Adtek is a growth marketing agency in Ho Chi Minh City that helps businesses grow revenue through digital transformation and data-driven strategy. We combine brand building with performance marketing and work with clients from strategy through execution.

When was Adtek founded?

Adtek was founded on May 5, 2022 in Ho Chi Minh City, with a mission to help Vietnamese businesses through digital transformation and sustainable growth.

How is a growth marketing agency different from a traditional ad agency?

Traditional agencies usually focus on individual campaigns or channels. A growth marketing agency looks at the whole business, from market, product and sales channels to operations and customer data, to find sustainable growth levers, and measures success with business metrics such as revenue, customer acquisition cost and customer lifetime value.

What services does Adtek offer?

Our main services are Brand Commerce (branding combined with performance marketing), Lead Generation, Creative Strategy, SEO, App User Acquisition, e-commerce marketplace management, Integrated Marketing Communication (IMC), KOL/KOC and livestream, growth consulting and CRM consulting.

Which businesses is Adtek a good fit for?

Adtek is a good fit for businesses that want measurable online revenue growth: brands selling on marketplaces and their own websites, companies that need qualified leads, and mobile apps that need more users. We have worked across real estate, fashion, e-commerce, cosmetics, pharmacy, education and electronics.

What experience does the Adtek team have?

Our team comes from leading Vietnamese technology and retail companies such as Vingroup, Lazada and Shopee, with more than 10 years of experience in digital marketing and e-commerce. Adtek has worked with more than 100 clients on more than 200 projects.

How is pricing determined?

Pricing depends on your goals, scope of work and media budget. Share your needs and expected monthly budget, and the Adtek team will get back to you with a tailored proposal.

How do I start working with Adtek?

Fill in the form on our Contact page, call +84 9323 494 34 or email tin.le@adtek.agency. We work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Does Adtek offer free resources for marketers?

Yes. We share our blog, marketing glossary, report library and Vietnam e-commerce map for free.

Is Adtek hiring?

We are always looking for people who love growth and data. See open positions on our Careers page.
